prompt: A person kneels over a fallen doe, their posture hunched against the chill. The animal lies on the snow, a small pool of crimson blossoming around it. The person’s hands rest on their thighs, palms down, fingers slightly curled. Behind them, partially obscured by swirling snow, a large, powerfully built ram with spiraling horns lowers its head, poised to charge. The person’s shoulders are drawn forward, a visible slump in their body indicating an inward turn. A husky, its thick fur ruff bristling, sits attentively nearby, its head cocked, watching the ram with bright eyes. A faint metallic odor drifts in the muted gray light of the afternoon sky.
